parity_drift_banner: Apply drift: the gateway may not reflect the saved policy. Check /health and re-apply.
devices_empty: No policy entries - every device follows the default rules.
audit_empty: No audit entries yet - policy changes will appear here.
audit_stale: Refresh failed - showing the last successful load.
audit_paused: Auto-refresh paused while viewing older entries.
token_prompt: Enter the panel token (PANEL_SECRET) to make changes. It is stored only in this browser.
band_confirm: This device is pinned by the router-side FULL_PROXY_SOURCES band. A dynamic policy outranks the band on the gateway - apply the override anyway?
purge_confirm: Delete ALL collected statistics (domains included)? The policy audit is not touched.
error_generic: The request was rejected - see the message.
delete_drift_warn: The entry was removed from the store, but the gateway apply FAILED - the device policy may still be live on the gateway. Check the drift banner and re-apply.
band_confirm_unknown: Could not check the router band list. This address MIGHT be a router-pinned band member - apply the override anyway?
stats_empty: No traffic recorded in this range.
stats_unreachable: The panel is unreachable - this is the last successful load.
framings_note: The definition of a day changed inside this window (zone / start time)
coverage_truncated: the range asked for starts before the oldest data held, so this covers less than requested
alias_write_failed: The device was added but its name was not saved - use Rename to retry.
settings_unchanged: Nothing changed - the values sent were already in force.
aliases_help: An alias is the identity-layer name: it survives the device's policy being removed, and a name you type outranks every importer.
stats_unavailable: The stats store did not answer - this is not a statement about your traffic.
history_failed: Could not read this device's history - an empty chart would have looked like no traffic.
